brief: Add a third storey to this caddy without moving or removing anything that is already on it.

requirements.evidence: New column piece:1,1,0;full + piece:1,1,1;full + piece:1,1,2;full; check_build meshClash clear, no errors. Level 2 is the third storey.
requirements.requirement: Add a third storey (level 2) to the caddy

requirements.evidence: get_build shows all 20 original nodes still present (3 bins, 4 notches, 3 accessories, original 4 pieces, caps, jointBolts, fused base); only adds were new base column, connector, joint bolt, snaps, caps. Direct stacking on piece:0,0,1;full was tried and refused BIN_RIM_IN_JOINT, so the third storey was built on a new adjoining column at 1,1 joined by connector:0#1,0|1,1 rather than on top of the binned cell.
requirements.requirement: Without moving or removing anything already on it

finish.summary: Added a third storey at 1,1 level 2 on a new adjoining column (1,1 levels 0-2, joined to 1,0 with a side connector). Stacking directly on the existing level-1 cell was refused (BIN_RIM_IN_JOINT: its bin rim blocks a stacking collar), so the level-2 cell sits beside/above the caddy rather than centred on 0,0. Nothing existing was moved or removed; house rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied; check_build clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
